conversation.user: hey, What are the general GPA and IELTS requirements for a UAEU English-taught masters program?

payload.content:
For a UAEU English-taught masters program, you need a bachelor's degree in a related field with a GPA of at least 3.0 out of 4.0, and an IELTS Academic score of 6.0 or its equivalent, with the test taken within two years before application.

If your bachelor's GPA is between 2.5 and below 3.0, you may be admitted conditionally, needing to take no more than 9 credit hours in the first semester and achieve a GPA of 3.0 in those hours to continue.

For IELTS, a conditional admission is possible with a score of 5.5, but you must then achieve 6.0 by the end of the first semester, take no more than 6 credit hours excluding intensive English initially, and earn a GPA of 3.0 in the first 9 credit-bearing hours.

Graduate application and requirements
- Apply through the official online link on the College of Graduate Studies admission page after choosing the degree and program. Program standards can be higher; meeting minimums does not guarantee admission.
- For a predominantly English-taught master's, the general baseline is a related accredited bachelor's degree, GPA 3.0/4.0 and IELTS Academic 6.0. IELTS 5.5 is a conditional route, not automatic eligibility: reach 6.0 by the end of the first semester, take at most 6 credit hours initially (excluding intensive English), and earn GPA 3.0 in the first 9 credit-bearing hours. Separate conditional GPA routes exist from 2.5; Arabic-taught master's programs list IELTS 4.0.
- General PhD minimums are master's GPA 3.0, bachelor's GPA 2.5, and IELTS 6.5 for English-medium study/English dissertation; Arabic-medium PhD lists IELTS 5.0. Language-test exemptions and additional college requirements may apply.
- PhD document checklist: certified bachelor's and master's degree certificates and transcripts; Ministry of Education equivalency/certificate recognition for the previous degree as required; English proficiency certificate; Arabic proficiency certificate for Arabic-medium PhD; two recommendation letters; CV; valid passport for all applicants, plus Emirates ID for UAE residents and family book for UAE nationals; and a personal photo. Passport and ID are not interchangeable alternatives.
For English-medium PhD study or an English dissertation, IELTS Academic6.5 or equivalent is required and the test score must be less than two years old at application. The page states two exception routes: a native English speaker with a master’s from an English-medium institution in a country where English is official; or an English-medium master’s graduate with evidence of IELTS Academic6.0 or equivalent at admission to that master’s. Individual colleges may impose additional or higher standards.

citations.title: UAEU Academic Standing, Enrollment Eligibility, and Progress Policy
citations.sourceVersion: Effective 2018-08-12; review due 2021-09-01; no supersession certification
citations.sourceSection: Policy scope; procedures 1, 2(a–j) and 3; PDF pages 1–3
citations.evidenceText: AE-05 applies outside the College of Medicine and Health Sciences. For undergraduates, good standing requires CGPA at least 2.00. After studying 21 credits, CGPA below 2.00 at semester end gives first probation. First or second probation normally permits the next regular semester with no more than 13 credits; CGPA must rise to at least 2.00 in the next semester for good standing. Remaining below 2.00 after first probation gives second probation. Procedure 2(e): remaining below 2.00 after second probation gives third academic probation AND academic dismissal, not alternative outcomes. Procedure 2(f) is a specific exception: third-probation CGPA at least 1.80 AND expected graduation within one academic year gives one semester to reach 2.00; failure then gives fourth probation AND dismissal. Summer is excluded from probation-period counting. Procedure 2(h) separately permits more than 13 credits when course evaluation has raised the CGPA; do not generalize that exception to every probation case. Official standing is in the student information system and notices are by university email. Published effective date: 12 August 2018, review due 1 September 2021; later supersession is not established. The assistant has not accessed an individual's standing or certified exception eligibility.

An Academic Grievance at UAEU is when a student claims they were mistreated or treated unfairly in an academic or enrollment matter.

An Academic Appeal is when a student claims that a university academic policy was incorrectly or erroneously applied to them, or when they request an exception to such a policy.

citations.evidenceText: Under the published UAEU AE-09 Student Academic Grievances and Appeals procedures, effective12August2018, an Academic Grievance is a student claim of mistreatment or unfair treatment in an academic or enrollment matter. Student Academic Grievances and Appeals Committee(SAGAC) is the standing university committee appointed by the Vice Chancellor to review and decide these matters, representing undergraduate and graduate affairs; the procedures separately list jurisdiction exceptions and escalation channels. These definitions do not decide an individual case.

conversation.user: How can a currently enrolled student request an official transcript in Arabic or English?

payload.content:
A currently enrolled student can request an official transcript in Arabic or English by accessing the Current Students Documents service through the official UAEU portal or app, logging in with UAE Pass or university credentials, then selecting either Academic Transcript Arabic or Academic Transcript English and submitting the request.

After submitting the transcript request, the student can track the request status through the My Requests section and will receive the processed official transcript at their university email address.

citations.title: UAEU Counseling and Wellbeing

citations.evidenceText: Counseling and Wellbeing is free for UAEU students. Appointment channels are the booking system, walk-in office or email. Insurance is required for psychiatry referral. Counseling attendance is not added to the academic record.
